svg.title: The workable interior kit
svg.desc: System families and disassembly sequence with owner-visible tradeoffs.
svg.text: The workable interior kit
Reference palette: warm timber, pale washable mineral surfaces and local satin metal at named duties.
Assembly families and depth consequences
F0 continuous fields
Local damage generally sacrifices and reinstates a finish patch.
F1 dry 400 mm
Finish and bedding of 18+2 requires no level change.
F2 deeper services
An additional 20 mm at a stair landing changes the adjoining 172.5 mm rise.
W1 dominant wall
18 face +7 capture +2 fit replaces the 27 mm face territory only where the complete substrate earns it.
W2/S1 accessible strip
150 high, 45 projection. 18 face leaves 27 gross enclosure/build-up.
G1 visible cover
Show where a genuine inspection, air or water duty earns metalwork. Keep live contents independently supported.
Controlled first release
1 · Isolate and clear a closed work bay
2 · Confirm substrate stays supported
3 · Release independent capture
4 · Lift, control load and place on protected first rest
5 · Replace piece and remove all equipment
6 · Recheck closure and return room to use
Check clip/anchor, pad, backing, weather/fire seals, resulting loads, cleaning and replaceable constituents as complete assemblies.
The target is a practical, quiet room with fewer distinct parts. Deeper access and every added visible seam must earn their upkeep.
